title: Valleyball — bluFlame, 4K for Windows
author: bluFlame, PRISM
notes: Breakpoint 2009, 4K intro, by xTr1m, Hel and raYn: a valley, its water and a beach ball raymarched and raytraced in one GLSL fragment shader on two triangles, the music by a synthesizer thread through waveOut. Its fine vertical stripes are its own, a colour mask by pixel column. MIRAGE-WIN32 answers opengl32.dll and winmm.dll in JavaScript; PRISM's gl.js draws with WebGL2. The intro ends itself after some 100 seconds.
